Wesley has made it clear that he doesn't want anything to do with me anymore, but I still need him to understand the consequences of his actions. Can you help me draft a message that conveys how serious I am about this situation?

It's important to communicate your feelings and the harm caused, while maintaining a certain level of respect and avoiding any form of blackmail or harassment. Here's a draft that aims to express your hurt, set boundaries, and convey the seriousness of the situation:

---

Subject: Important Matter Regarding Our Past Conversations

Dear Wesley,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to you not to try and reignite our past relationship, but to address a serious issue that has recently come to light and has left me feeling deeply hurt and betrayed.

Before we break up, you had access to my phone and, like any couple in a trusted relationship, I had no reason to question your intentions or the respect you would have for my privacy. I am now aware that you have saved some very personal and explicit images of mine, without my knowledge or consent.

This discovery has been incredibly painful for me. These images were never meant to be shared with anyone outside of our relationship, and the fact that they are now in your possession feels like a violation of my trust and our shared intimacy.

I understand that you have made it clear that you want to move on, and I respect that decision. However, I cannot simply forget about this situation. The fact that these images exist and are in your control has caused me significant emotional distress.

I am writing to ask that you delete these images immediately and confirm to me that you have done so. I also want to make it clear that if I find out that these images have been shared or are being used in any way that is harmful to me, I will not hesitate to take appropriate legal action.

This is not a threat, but a statement of the seriousness of this situation. I am not looking to punish you, but to protect myself and ensure that my trust and privacy are respected.

I would appreciate your prompt response to this matter. I am more than willing to speak further about this if you wish, but please understand that I am extremely upset and need some form of reassurance that this situation will be resolved.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in this matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

Subject: URGENT: Immediate Action Required Regarding Your Possession of My Private Images

Wesley,

I am writing to you today not with the hope of reconciliation, but to address a serious and unacceptable breach of trust that you have committed against me. I will not sugarcoat this message, as the matter at hand is far too serious to warrant any Such delicacy.

During our relationship, you had access to my personal belongings, including my phone. I trusted you implicitly, a trust that you have violated in the most intimate and hurtful way imaginable. You have saved personal and explicit images of me, without my knowledge or consent, and have effectively invaded my privacy and betrayed my trust.

I have become aware of this gross invasion of my privacy, and I am furious. The emotional distress this has caused me is immense, and I will not stand idly by while you continue to exploit these images for your own gratification or, worse yet, choose to share them with others.
